assumptions.choice: EMA(EMA(200)) uses period 200 for the inner EMA as well, matching the standard DEMA formula DEMA(n) = 2*EMA(n) - EMA(EMA(n),n)
assumptions.reason: Spec states the formula but does not restate the period for the inner EMA; the standard DEMA definition reuses the same period

assumptions.choice: All references to 'price' (close > DEMA200, crossing Upper/Lower) use the bar close price
assumptions.reason: Only OHLCV bar data is available; no intrabar/tick price exists to distinguish from close

assumptions.choice: Size computed as int(available_cash / close_price) at entry, i.e. floor of 100% of current cash divided by price, no commission buffer
assumptions.reason: Spec requires 100% of capital allocation; integer share sizing is required since fractional shares aren't supported, and no explicit commission buffer is specified

assumptions.choice: No short entries; strategy is long-only
assumptions.reason: Spec only describes long entry/exit rules and does not mention shorting (canonical default)

assumptions.choice: Interpreted as a per-bar state check (close[0] < dema200[0]), not a crossing event
assumptions.reason: Spec explicitly distinguishes 'crossing below Lower' (a cross condition) from 'a close below DEMA(200)' (stated as a plain condition, no crossing language used)

assumptions.choice: Single pending-order attribute reset on Completed/Canceled/Margin/Rejected, blocking new orders while one is pending
No special handling added; the provided H1 feed is used as-is
assumptions.reason: Spec's 'Timeframes H1 and above' is an applicability statement, not a resampling requirement, and the harness supplies only a single H1 feed
